scores.evidence: Every learner-facing string uses です・ます. 体言止め appears only in list rows, options and checklist labels. The text reads naturally, with no 翻訳調 and no pressure phrases. Wrong-option feedback stays within 2 sentences. Each one names the misconception and then gives the right idea, for example q3 c 「止めるのは拒否ルール（deny）です。確認ルールは止めずに、あなたに確認を求めます。」. Options have the same form in every question, and e6 a–d share one form. The link text 「権限モードの公式ドキュメント（日本語）」 names its destination. The course references still match the published course.json: the prerequisite 「第1回｜最初のタスクを任せる」 and summary-next 「次は「第3回｜探索→計画→実装→コミット」です。」 match the lesson titles. The e5 explanation says hooks are covered in 第8回, and the course title for cc-08-hooks-mcp is 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」. One small wobble remains: 止める is used loosely for an ask rule (e1 a, e1 explanation, auto-limit). It is listed in niceToHave.

measure.mjs reports prose 2222 (budget 1,200–2,400), read 2466, est 19.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20), 13 questions and 2 practice sections. lessons:lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings, so every sentence and paragraph is within budget. The lesson sits near the top of both the prose and the time budget. modes-table introduces all 6 modes at once. rules-defs adds three rule terms, plus 許可ルール inline. The first sentence of rewind-how holds two steps. The lesson works on a phone but is dense, so load stays at 3.

The core terms are defined before use, with English on first use, and they match the glossary: 権限モード（permission mode）, 分類器（classifier）, 権限ルール（permission rule） and チェックポイント（checkpoint）. The diagram labels (拒否ルール, 確認ルール, 許可ルール) match rules-defs and the glossary. auto-lead links 分類器 to the 「安全チェック」 label used in 2-1. Some first visible uses still lack English. リポジトリ is glossed only in the hidden q0 b feedback, and セッション only in the hidden q0 a feedback. データベース (rewind-table) and エディタ (rewind-check) have no English. プランモード gets its English one block after its first use. These are common loanwords that the learner still reads correctly, so they are listed in niceToHave.

The lesson declares one locale, jp, which matches the course locales ["jp"]. Every field has Japanese text. The diagram has a full Japanese alt text and caption. The plain-text fields (summary-ask, the rules-checklist labels) carry no markdown. The link text names its destination. lessons:lint --strict reports no locale-plain-string findings.

niceToHave: check-quiz: e1 option a uses 止める for an ask rule, but q3 c says 「確認ルールは止めずに」. Option a: 「付けない。autoモードで進め、止めたい操作は確認ルールにする」→「付けない。autoモードで進め、確認したい操作は確認ルールにする」. Explanation: 「止めたい操作はルールで止めます」→「確認したい操作はルールで確認を挟みます」
auto-limit: the same loose use of 止める for rules that include ask — 「2-3のルールで止めて、人が見ます。」→「2-3のルールで確認を挟み、人が見ます。」

check-quiz: e6 names the rules by their keys (「`deny` に」「`ask` に」), but q4 uses the rule names (「拒否ルールに」「確認ルールに」). Both read correctly, but one wording across both questions is smoother — 「`deny` に `Bash(gh pr create *)`」→「拒否ルールに `Bash(gh pr create *)`」, and the same for options b and c (「`ask` に」→「確認ルールに」)
rewind-how: the first sentence holds two steps — 「入力欄が空のときにEscを2回押すか `/rewind` を実行し、戻す時点と、コード・会話・両方のどれを戻すかを選びます。」→「入力欄が空のときにEscを2回押すか、`/rewind` を実行します。戻す時点と、コード・会話・両方のどれを戻すかを選びます。」
modes-check: the only English gloss for リポジトリ is in hidden feedback (q0 b). Put it where every learner sees it — 「初めて触るリポジトリで」→「初めて触るリポジトリ（repository）で」
rewind-table: a katakana term has no English on first use — 「（push、データベース、デプロイ）」→「（push、データベース（database）、デプロイ）」
rewind-check: a katakana term has no English on first use — 「自分がエディタで書き換えた」→「自分がエディタ（editor）で書き換えた」
hook-predict: every learner first sees セッション in the q0 explanation, but its English is only in the hidden option a feedback — 「ターミナルとVS Codeの対話セッションは」→「ターミナルとVS Codeの対話セッション（session）は」
modes-table: プランモード appears before its English, which only comes in modes-switch — 「**プランモード**（`plan`）」→「**プランモード**（plan mode、`plan`）」, and in modes-switch 「プランモード（plan mode）と進みます」→「プランモードと進みます」
example-steps: the sentence in ex-pattern reads a little stiffly — 「続きが何でも、なくても一致します。」→「続きに何があっても、なくても一致します。」
hook-lead: a nominal fragment in body text — 「どこまで任せ、どこで止めるか。まず予想してみましょう。」→「どこまで任せ、どこで止めるかを、まず予想してみましょう。」
summary: Full review of sha256:8c52cb12321e5ea5 (content/courses/claude-code/lessons/cc-02-permissions.lesson.json). I compared it with the draft at commit 3528a78 (sha256:b119e1c419d1e206), and the only change is courseId, from vibe-coding to claude-code. No learner-facing text changed. I checked every string again against the published course.json. The prerequisite, the next-lesson title (第3回) and the hooks reference (第8回) all match the course's lesson titles. lessons:lint --strict is clean. measure.mjs reports prose 2222 (budget 1,200–2,400) and est 19.9 min (estMinutes 20). I found no (a)–(e) errors. These points remain as niceToHave: 止める is used loosely for ask rules (e1, auto-limit); e6 names the rules by key while q4 uses the rule names; a few loanwords lack English on first visible use (リポジトリ, セッション, データベース, エディタ, プランモード); and rewind-how has an uneven rhythm. Scores: voice 4, load 3, prior 3, a11y_l10n 4 (mean 3.5). Verdict: pass.
